ad: p02 SUPER ile taban kurucusu (degisken adi duzeltildi)
kod:
CLASS A
    PUBLIC
    DIM x AS I32
    CONSTRUCTOR(ax AS I32)
        x = ax
    END CONSTRUCTOR
END CLASS
CLASS B EXTENDS A
    PUBLIC
    CONSTRUCTOR(bx AS I32)
        SUPER(bx)
    END CONSTRUCTOR
END CLASS
DIM nb AS B = NEW B(5)
PRINT nb.x

CLASS Sayi
    PUBLIC:
    DIM v AS I32
    MAGIC ADD(other AS Sayi) AS Sayi
        DIM r AS Sayi = NEW Sayi()
        r.v = v + other.v
        RETURN r
    END MAGIC
END CLASS
DIM a AS Sayi = NEW Sayi()
DIM b AS Sayi = NEW Sayi()
DIM c AS Sayi = NEW Sayi()
a.v = 1
b.v = 3
c = a + b
PRINT c.v
